metadata.title: WF-06 · YT Agent Crew — complete multi-agent production structure

content: Isme woh sab kuch ha [attachment: Monarch workflow Yt Agents.txt] — voice note describing the full multi-agent YouTube automation crew: manager agent (owns whole YT algorithm + approves every agent), ideas/research agent, script writer agent, voiceover agent, video production editor agent, upload/metadata agent; all agents connected to the manager during and after work, like brothers, sharing what/how/why. Instruction: do NOT write code first, build the complete structure and fill any gaps/flaws that stop it reaching tabahi level.

WF-06 structure: added two agents beyond the user's six roles — A07 WARDEN (compliance/rights, veto power) because the missing compliance layer is what took Monarch Cam from 955,681 to 16 views, and A08 ORACLE (post-publish analytics) because the user's design had no learning loop closing back into research. Also fixed gaps: no shared show file, no artifact-first handoff, no numbered feedback format, no 3-strike escalation, no evidence standard, no bounded persuasion doctrine, no human publish gate.
